hints.title: Bitmask Subset Representation
hints.text: With n <= 10, there are only 2^10 = 1024 possible subsets of branches to keep open.

hints.title: All-Pairs Shortest Path
hints.text: For each bitmask subset of open branches, run Floyd-Warshall on the induced subgraph using roads between open branches.

hints.title: Distance Verification
hints.text: Verify that every pair of open nodes u and v has shortest distance at most maxDistance. If so, increment valid count.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing all 2^n subsets with Floyd-Warshall all-pairs shortest paths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive branch search without bitmasking is unstructured.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize n <= 10 constraint allows 2^n Floyd-Warshall checks in ~10^6 operations.
